title: Toddler in Hooded Winter Suit on Front Lawn, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sweet mid-century candid portrait of a young child bundled up in a dark hooded coat, matching trousers, and white shoes, standing on a sloping residential lawn. Behind the child stands a leafless sapling and a classic suburban home with brick foundation accents. Featuring classic deckled or scalloped edges, this snapshot captures the simple warmth and domestic charm of postwar American family life.
